When Will My Order Ship?

Orders placed before 11am PST will ship on the same business day. Otherwise they will ship the following business day.

What Shipping Methods Are Available?

We offer free standard shipping to the continental US. Please see options at checkout for express and non-continental US shipping options.

How Can I Track My Order?

Know what’s going on with your order at all times by logging into your account or looking up your order. It may take up to 24 hours from shipment for tracking information to display, depending on the carrier.

Do You Ship Internationally?

Not right now. We ship to all 50 US states and APO/FPO bases.

How Does Subscription Work?

We offer 3 product subscription options. Choose whether to receive 1 product every month, 3 products every 3 months, or 6 products every 6 months. The more you buy, the more you save.

How Can I Contact Customer Service?

You can chat with us Monday through Friday, 9am-5pm EST or message us anytime. Want to talk on the phone? Just message us with your name, number and the best time to reach you during standard business hours and one of our CBD mavens will give you a call.You can contact us directly at (888)- 676- 2711 during our hours of operation; 9:00AM - 5:00PM EST.

How Do I Start A Return Or Exchange?

Please complete the return request  here.

What Is Your Return Policy?

Return requests will be reviewed by NextEvo, Inc. within 3 business days.  NextEvo, Inc. is responsible for the cost of the shipping charges for the return of goods. Return Authorizations (RA) will be issued upon NextEvo, Inc.  All returns are negotiable and at the discretion of NextEvo, Inc. Conditions for Returns :If product is delivered damaged, it must be reported within 3 weeks of the order date.  Replacement inventory will be shipped from NextEvo, Inc. upon issuance of the RA.If a consumer returns a product to your retail store within 30 days of their purchase, it must be reported within 30 days of the store return.  A credit will be issued upon issuance of the RA.If the initial order inventory has not sold through within 18 months of the order, a credit will be issued for unsold goods upon issuance of the RA.
